title: Unsaved-changes dialog does not restore focus to trigger element on dismiss via Stay (WCAG 2.4.3)
requirementSource: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.3 (Focus Order) — when a component that receives focus is dismissed, focus should return to the triggering element to maintain a meaningful navigation sequence
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Terms and Conditions page (/locations/1604/settings/terms-conditions).
Edit a row name to make the form dirty (Save button enables).
Click the language filter trigger and select a different language (e.g., 'Spanish (Mexico)') to trigger the unsaved-changes guard dialog.
Wait for the alertdialog to appear (role="alertdialog").
Verify focus is trapped inside the dialog (Tab cycles through dialog buttons without escaping).
Click the 'Stay' button to dismiss the dialog without discarding changes.
Evaluate document.activeElement — observe it is <body>, not the filter trigger.
expectedBehavior: After dismissing the unsaved-changes dialog via 'Stay', focus should return to the element that triggered the dialog — the language filter trigger (data-testid="terms-conditions-language-filter-trigger"). postDialogFocusId should equal preDialogFocusId.
actualBehavior: After clicking 'Stay', document.activeElement is <body>. postDialogFocusId = "body", expected = preDialogFocusId (the filter trigger's data-testid). Focus is dumped to the document body rather than being restored to the trigger.
mcpEvidence: Diagnosed 2026-08-07 by graft-takeover worker (grid-six run): TC-TNC-CORE-090 recorded preDialogFocusId, triggered dialog, clicked Stay, compared postDialogFocusId. Evidence artifact: .claude/state/ua-worker/chips/graft-takeover/out-f6/GRID-SIX.md § TC-TNC-CORE-090.
baselineEvidence: The unsaved-changes guard dialog is a new-site Angular pattern. The old site does not have an equivalent inline-guard dialog on the terms and conditions page. No old-site equivalent exists.
